entries.title: I Chronicles 15:2
segments: Our mistakes in times past should make us wiser in future; should lead us to avoid the errors into which, from presumption, ignorance, or inattention, we may have fallen; and should engage us in the performance of all duties which we have neglected.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:5
segments:
vv 5-7. 
 
  Kohath--Merari--Gershom; the three sons of Levi.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:8
segments:
vv 8-10. 
 
  Elizaphan--Hebron--Uzziel; Hebron and Uzziel were the sons of Kohath; Elizaphan, or Elzaphan, was the son of Ussiel, and the grandson of Kohath.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:11
segments: Zadok and Abiathar; Zadok ministered as priest at Gibeon, where were the tabernacle, the brazen altar, and the daily sacrifice.  See
.  Abiathar was the regular high-priest officiating at Jerusalem.  See note to

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:12
segments:
Sanctify yourselves; by cleansing themselves from all ceremonial and moral pollution, and by the performance of those duties which God had prescribed for that purpose. 
 
Peculiar sanctity becomes the ministers of religion, and especially when engaged in religious duties; they should be watchful not to indulge in any thing offensive to God, or that tends to unfit them for his holy service.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:13
segments: Made a breach upon us; in the destruction of Uzzah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:16
segments: Singing is an important part of divine worship, and when rightly performed is acceptable to God.  Those who engage in it should never forget that God looks upon the heart, and requires that those who worship him should worship him in spirit and in truth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:26
segments: Helped the Levites; by enabling them to carry the ark in safety to its place without suffering any calamity, such as that which had befallen Uzzah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:28
segments: Though that fervor of devotion which the Holy Spirit inspires, and which is manifested by those who are under his influence, is often despised and treated as degrading, especially to the rich, the great, and the powerful, this will not prevent true Christians from being zealous in the service of God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 15:29
segments: She despised him; she thought that he degraded himself, by thus joining with the priests and the people in their expressions of religious joy.
